name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>. Accurately describes the function: a generic one-shot AIL SFX player driving the primary shared sample slot (data_fd2_audio_sfx_sample_handle_0 @ 0x53EE4). The 'with_handle' descriptor pairs it against the sibling fd2_play_sfx_sample_from_bank which is structurally identical but drives sample slot 1; both names read naturally and unambiguously. No Ghidra address residue in the name.
purpose: Generic one-shot AIL (Miles Sound System) SFX player on the primary shared sample slot (handle_0); plays a sample selected by id from a bank, or stops the slot when id == -1.
logic_summary: Silently returns if any of three gates fail: SFX driver not available (0x53EF1), SFX globally disabled (0x51E62), or scripted-cinematic/terrain mute active (0x540FF != 0). Otherwise it always issues AIL_stop_sample on the shared slot 0 handle. If sfx_id == -1 it returns (stop-only path). Else it resolves the bank entry (entry = sfx_table_base + sfx_id*4) and reads two dwords: sample byte-offset at entry+6 and sample end-offset at entry+10; length = end - offset. It then AIL_init_sample, AIL_set_sample_address(handle, base+offset, length), AIL_set_sample_loop_count(handle, loop_count), AIL_start_sample(handle).
signature: void fd2_play_sfx_with_handle(uint32 sfx_table_base, int sfx_id, int loop_count)

params.name: sfx_table_base
params.semantics: Base pointer of the SFX sample bank buffer (an FDOTHER.DAT entry; commonly the FDOTHER.DAT[0x1F] SFX bank, or the status-effect bank in data_fd2_audio_status_effect_sfx_handle_ptr). Used both to index the per-sample directory (base + sfx_id*4 + 6/10) and as the base added to the sample byte-offset to form the absolute sample address.
params.reason: Accurate: it is the sample table / bank base. No address residue; type matches body usage (pointer arithmetic on a 32-bit value).

params.name: sfx_id
params.semantics: Sample index into the bank directory; selects which sample to play. The sentinel -1 routes to the stop-only path (stop the slot and return without programming/starting a sample).
params.reason: Accurate and conventional; the -1 sentinel comparison confirms a signed semantics. No address residue.

params.name: loop_count
params.semantics: Loop count passed straight to AIL_set_sample_loop_count for the started sample (callers typically pass 1 for one-shot).
params.reason: Accurate, matches AIL_set_sample_loop_count argument. No address residue.

returns.semantics: No return value. Side effect only: programs and starts (or stops) AIL sample slot 0.

notes: Disassembly (43 insns, 6 BBs) confirms the source at audio.c:159-184 is a faithful reproduction: gates -> AIL_stop_sample(slot0) -> -1 stop-only return -> entry=base+id*4, offset=[entry+6], end=[entry+10], init/set_address(base+offset,end-offset)/set_loop_count/start. __CHK(0x1c) prologue and the unused PUSH/POP EBX are compiler-injected, correctly documented as not-source in the existing comment. Source comment (audio.c:136-158) and Ghidra plate are both accurate and semantically consistent with the refined understanding, so neither was modified. The plate's illustrative 'Common caller pattern' line uses the older short name play_sfx_with_handle in prose only -- not a contradiction, so left as-is per src-is-authority/consistency-is-enough rule. No globals are written; reads are the three gate flags plus the slot-0 handle (the bank directory dwords are read through the sfx_table_base parameter, not a global).
